snippet.title: Grid Forge TD trailer
snippet.description:
A trailer for Grid Forge TD.

Grid Forge TD is an incremental tower defense game. You control the enemy path by placing tetronimoes. 

The demo is live on steam now: 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4099130/Grid_Forge_TD_Demo/

It's also available in the browser on itch, but there are some performance and sound issues:
https://yarrichar.itch.io/grid-forge-td
